7 Brew Sugar Cookie Chai Latte: Price, Calories & Recipe

A medium Sugar Cookie Chai Latte is about $4.65, with 300 calories, 0 mg of caffeine and 56 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Sugar Cookie Chai Latte allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists Milk for the Sugar Cookie Chai Latte. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Sugar Cookie Chai Latte

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Sugar Cookie Chai Latte?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Sugar Cookie Chai Latte at Home (Copycat Recipe)

Three syrups do the bakery work. Cupcake is the lead flavor, vanilla is the bridge, white chocolate is the richness. Keep the chai concentrate strong so the spices survive the sweetness.

For one medium Sugar Cookie Chai Latte

  • 6 oz spiced chai concentrate
  • 6 oz milk
  • 1/2 oz cupcake syrup
  • 1/4 oz vanilla syrup
  • 1/2 oz white chocolate sauce
  • A full cup of ice for the iced version
  1. Stir the three syrups into the chai concentrate until the white chocolate dissolves.
  2. Add the milk and pour over ice, or steam everything together for hot.
  3. Optional finish: cold foam and a cinnamon sprinkle, the popular stand order.

No cupcake syrup? Cake batter extract plus a pinch more vanilla is the common substitute, but it lands thinner. Say so in your expectations, not just your shopping list. Chiller version: blend the same build with the ice (340 calories for a medium per the guide).

7 Brew Sugar Cookie Chai Latte FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Sugar Cookie Chai Latte?

A medium iced Sugar Cookie Chai Latte has 300 calories. A small has 220 and a large 370, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Sugar Cookie Chai Latte?

7 Brew does not publish a caffeine figure for its chai drinks, so there is no official number. Pages printing 40 to 130 mg for this drink are inventing it. Chai is black-tea based, so it is not caffeine-free, just far below the coffee drinks.

How much does a 7 Brew Sugar Cookie Chai Latte cost?

Roughly $3.95 for a small, $4.65 for a medium and $5.45 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Sugar Cookie Chai Latte?

56 g in a medium.

What is in a Sugar Cookie Chai Latte?

A chai latte plus three flavors: cupcake syrup, vanilla syrup and white chocolate. That is the official menu line, 'Cupcake + Vanilla + White Chocolate,' and a 7 Brew barista confirmed the same three in the fan group. There is no actual cookie in it. The bakery flavor is built entirely from the syrups against the chai spices.

Is the Sugar Cookie Chai Latte a secret menu drink?

No. It is a regular member of the official chai line, listed on the menu beside Brewchata and Salted Honey. Some fan pages call it secret because not every stand's board shows the full chai list, but it is a standard item in the official guide, and it is served year-round, not just for the holidays.

Is there a sugar-free version?

No, and this one cannot be faked. Neither cupcake syrup nor white chocolate sauce comes in a sugar-free form, so the guide lists no sugar-free Sugar Cookie Chai Latte. One drink-database page offers a 'go sugar-free' toggle and then admits on the same page that you cannot get this one sugar-free. Believe the admission. Half sweet is the real lighter order. Every drink that does offer a sugar-free version is compared on our sugar-free page.

Sugar Cookie Chai Latte vs Sugar Cookie Blondie: what is the difference?

The chai is this drink: a tea base with cupcake, vanilla and white chocolate, 300 calories for a medium iced. The Sugar Cookie Blondie is a coffee build, the same three flavors added to the Blondie breve. Fans mix them up because the flavor trio is identical. If you want no coffee, order the chai by its full name.

How do I make a sugar cookie chai latte at home?

Build the chai latte (equal parts chai concentrate and milk), then stir in 1/2 oz cupcake syrup, 1/4 oz vanilla syrup and 1/2 oz white chocolate sauce. Use real cupcake syrup if you can find it. One ranking copycat swaps in cake batter extract and skips the cupcake amount entirely, which is why it tastes close but off. The full recipe is in the recipe section on this page.
